title: Nano-Diosmin mitigates EAC-induced renal injury through Nrf2-mediated antioxidant activation and NF-kappaB-dependent apoptotic suppression.
authors: Alshammari, Ahmad Najem; Alfawaz, Mohammed Saleh; Oraby, Fatma; Mohamed, Ahmed M; Elmorsy, Ekramy M; Mohamed, Suzan S A; Atta, Marwa M F; El-Raghi, Ali Ali
one_liner_zh: 该文研究纳米地奥司明对小鼠EAC肿瘤相关肾损伤的保护作用，涉及Nrf2/NF-kB通路与分子对接，但核心是药物药效与肾保护，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The present study provides the first evidence of the anticancer-associated renoprotective efficacy of diosmin (DI) delivered via chitosan nanoparticles (DI-CHNPs) in mice bearing Ehrlich ascites carcinoma (EAC). Sixty female Swiss albino mice were divided into six groups: controls, DI, DI-CHNPs, EAC, EAC+DI, and EAC+DI-CHNPs. Treatments involved DI or DI-CHNPs (100 mg/kg/day) for 20 days with or without tumor induction. DI-CHNPs significantly reduced tumor burden, as evidenced by lower body weight gain, abdominal circumference, tumor volume, and viable tumor cell count, and these effects were superior to free DI. DI-CHNPs also prolonged survival and improved renal function markers (urea, creatinine, electrolytes), indicating that attenuation of tumor progression was accompanied by reduced secondary renal injury. Antioxidant defenses in kidney tissues were strengthened through increased superoxide dismutase, catalase, glutathione peroxidase activities, and reduced glutathione levels, alongside reduced malondialdehyde. DI-CHNPs activated the Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1 pathway while down-regulated the inflammatory pathways controlling genes (Tgfb 1, Nfkb 1, Il6) and pro-apoptotic markers (Bax, Caspase-3), with increased Bcl-2 expression. Histopathological and ultrastructural analyses confirmed superior renal protection compared with DI. Molecular docking provided in silico supportive evidence for DI interaction with Nrf2, NF-kappaB, caspase-3, and TGF-beta-related molecular targets involved in oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis. Overall, the findings suggest that nanoparticle formulation enhanced the therapeutic performance of DI, likely through improved stability and sustained-release properties, resulting in superior antitumor efficacy and attenuation of tumor-associated renal injury.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次提供了地奥司明（diosmin, DI）经壳聚糖纳米颗粒递送（DI-CHNPs）在携带艾氏腹水癌（Ehrlich ascites carcinoma, EAC）小鼠中具有抗癌相关肾脏保护作用的证据。将六十只雌性瑞士白化小鼠分为六组：对照组、DI组、DI-CHNPs组、EAC组、EAC+DI组和EAC+DI-CHNPs组。治疗涉及DI或DI-CHNPs（100 mg/kg/天）连续20天，伴或不伴肿瘤诱导。DI-CHNPs显著减轻肿瘤负担，表现为体重增加减少、腹围减小、肿瘤体积缩小及存活肿瘤细胞计数降低，且这些效果优于游离DI。DI-CHNPs还延长了生存期并改善了肾功能标志物（尿素、肌酐、电解质），表明肿瘤进展的减缓伴随继发性肾损伤的减轻。肾组织中的抗氧化防御通过超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶活性及还原型谷胱甘肽水平升高而增强，同时丙二醛水平降低。DI-CHNPs激活了Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1通路，同时下调了调控炎症通路相关基因（Tgfb 1、Nfkb 1、Il6）和促凋亡标志物（Bax、Caspase-3），并增加Bcl-2表达。组织病理学和超微结构分析证实，与DI相比，DI-CHNPs具有更优的肾脏保护作用。分子对接提供了计算机模拟支持性证据，表明DI与Nrf2、NF-kappaB、caspase-3及TGF-beta相关分子靶点相互作用，这些靶点涉及氧化应激、炎症和凋亡。总体而言，研究结果表明，纳米颗粒制剂增强了DI的治疗性能，可能通过改善稳定性和缓释特性，从而实现更优的抗肿瘤疗效并减轻肿瘤相关肾损伤。
